digest.component_or_area: bridge workflows and core push adapter
propositions: Both bridge workflows (reconcile-bridge and reconcile-canary) must migrate from inline YAML CAS loops to single core push action invocations with strict synchronous delivery.
Reconciler workflow must preserve exact bot identity and commit subject while pushing dirty state, remaining red on failure; canary workflow must invoke strict synchronous push-only delivery.
Stale synthetic raw-git exemption rationale in test_raw_git_write_lint.py referencing overturned ticket 4c4f must be replaced with generic reviewed-fixture rationale.

All acceptance criteria including CAS loop removal, strict workflow delivery, reconciler identity preservation, and documentation of standing decisions must be verified through two executable workflow smoke tests with real git.
